query:
UPDATE property_options
        SET property_definition_id = $2,
            display_order = COALESCE(
                (
                    SELECT MAX(display_order) + 1
                    FROM property_options
                    WHERE property_definition_id = $2
                ),
                0
            ),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING
            id,
            property_definition_id,
            display_order,
            number_value,
            string_value,
            color,
            created_at,
            updated_at
